item.title: Which GPU should you rent for LLM inference?
item.description: A living guide to choosing a GPU for LLM inference: how many H100, H200 or MI300X GPUs a model needs, when the interconnect matters, and what it costs per hour. Updated quarterly.

item.title: H200 vs MI300X: what you're actually paying for
item.description: Memory, interconnect, and price compared across NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI300X: what the extra 51 GB buys, why PCIe vs NVLink decides multi-GPU scaling, and what a GPU-hour really costs on the neoclouds.
